name: github-intro-tutorial
description: GitHub Skills interactive tutorial — Introduction to GitHub. Teaches new developers the four core GitHub workflows: creating branches, committing files, opening pull requests, and merging. Originally a GitHub Actions-powered template repo from github.com/skills.
author: GitHub Skills

security_review.notes: Pure markdown steps, PNG screenshots, and GitHub Actions workflow YAML that calls pinned Actions (actions/checkout@v4, GrantBirki/comment@v2.1.1) via GITHUB_TOKEN. No scripts, no executables, no eval, no shell injection.
